object: complete dock + pulley in the fully lowered water-contact pose (Pulley_Lower final frame)
lens: Shared three-area-light rig, orthographic lens at gameplay pitch (~43 deg), ortho scale 10.6 identical across all four directions
auditCriteria: rope/bucket/deck/water clipping in the keyed pose

north.notes: Bucket sits visibly in the water clear of the deck, ledge, and piles; the fall rope stays taut from the guide to the hook; the crank arm holds its rotated pose.

south.notes: The lowered rope passes cleanly through open air beyond the platform edge; no member of the frame intersects the rope line.

east.notes: Waterline crosses the lower staves believably; hook and bail stay engaged; ledge unclipped beside the drop line.

west.notes: From over the dock the lowered pose keeps rope, jib, and guide wheel aligned on one line with no divergence.

defectsFoundAndFixed: First pass lowered the bucket straight through the original ledge position (hard clip) — resolved by relocating the ledge out of the drop line before any PASS was recorded.
